about_short_description.short_description: Coupl is a neobank that helps couples easily manage their money together.

product.name: Coupl Account
product.description: A joint wallet or bank account for couples to manage money together, allowing deposits, payments, and transactions under shared control.

product.name: Coupl Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that provides access to Coupl’s financial services, including account management, transactions, and security features.

product.name: Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPIs)
product.description: Reloadable electronic wallets and card-based prepaid instruments issued through partners, enabling payments and fund transfers within regulatory limits.

product.name: Transaction Processing Services
product.description: Services enabling payment requests, fund transfers, balance checks, and other financial transactions through the Coupl platform.
